records.text: Carly said her father, a military police officer stationed with Michael Aquino in '82, investigated pentagrams on the base and was later ordered with his partner to stop investigating child-abuse cases because military police did not investigate felonies.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep BKcOm32ZEGk)

appearances.snippet: Top comments from yesterday's episode came from Carly. Carly writes crazy fact. My dad was stationed with Lieutenant Aquino back in 82. My dad was an MP, was investigating pentagrams on the base. Then when the child abuse cases popped up, they made my dad and his partner quit investigating due to, quote, MPs don't investigate felonies.

verification.notes: The episode accurately reads an anonymous viewer message, but Carly and her father are not identified sufficiently to authenticate the account. Searches found historical reporting about Aquino and later Presidio investigations, but nothing that verifies this father's claimed 1982 experience or the quoted order.
